title.en: Let's Be Friends! Relationship Management Program

learningGoal.ko: 친구와 친해질 수 있는 말과 행동을 알고 상황에 맞게 사용할 수 있다.
learningGoal.en: Can know words and actions that help make friends, and use them to fit the situation.

title.en: It was a joke to me, but my friend is upset

story.ko: 나는 친구를 웃겨주려고 친구의 연필을 살짝 숨겼어요.
story.en: I secretly hid my friend's pencil to make them laugh.

story.ko: 그런데 친구는 연필을 찾으며 웃지 않고 표정이 좋지 않아요.
story.en: But my friend isn't laughing while looking for the pencil, and looks unhappy.

imageBrief.ko: 초등학교 교실 / 주인공이 친구 연필을 살짝 숨기는 모습 / 친구는 연필을 찾고 있음 / 표정은 과하게 강조하지 않기
imageBrief.en: Elementary classroom; main character secretly hides a friend's pencil; friend is looking for it; don't exaggerate facial expressions

question.en: How does the friend looking for the pencil feel?

text.ko: 친구의 얼굴을 봐요. 웃지 않고 연필을 찾고 있어요.
text.en: Look at your friend's face. They aren't smiling and they're looking for the pencil.

question.en: Why did my friend feel that way?

text.en: Worried because the pencil went missing

ack.ko: 그럴 수 있어요. 아끼는 물건이 없어지면 걱정돼요.
ack.en: That could be. Losing something you care about is worrying.

ack.ko: 그럴 수 있어요. 누가 가져갔다고 생각하면 마음이 불편해요.
ack.en: That could be. Thinking someone took it feels uncomfortable.

text.en: Upset at not finding the pencil.

ack.ko: 그럴 수 있어요. 찾아도 없으면 속상해요.
ack.en: That could be. It's upsetting when you can't find it.

text.en: Thought the friend's prank was funny.

ack.ko: 그렇게 느낄 수도 있어요. 그런데 친구의 표정을 다시 한번 볼까요?
ack.en: Maybe. But let's look at your friend's face once more.

principle.ko: 나는 친구를 웃겨주려고 장난을 했어요. 하지만 친구는 속상하거나 걱정할 수 있어요.
principle.en: I played a prank to make my friend laugh. But my friend may feel upset or worried.

more.ko: 예를 들어, 내가 아끼는 물건이 갑자기 없어지면 나도 걱정되고 속상할 거예요.
more.en: For example, if something I care about suddenly went missing, I'd feel worried and upset too.

question.ko: 친구의 표정을 보니 내가 생각한 것과 다른 것 같아요. 어떻게 하면 좋을까요?
question.en: My friend's face looks different from what I expected. What should I do?

text.en: Think it's a fun joke and keep hiding it.

feedback.ko: 친구가 왜 그런 표정을 지었는지 생각해봐요.
feedback.en: Think about why your friend made that face.

text.ko: 친구가 찾을 때까지 아무 말도 하지 않아요.
text.en: Say nothing until the friend finds it.

feedback.ko: 없어진 물건이 있다면 속상하겠죠? 친구 마음을 생각해봐요.
feedback.en: You'd be upset if something of yours went missing, right? Think about your friend's feelings.

text.ko: 연필을 돌려주고 "미안해. 나는 네가 웃을 줄 알았어."라고 말해요.
text.en: Give the pencil back and say, "Sorry. I thought you'd laugh."

feedback.ko: 용기 있는 선택이네요. 미안한 마음이 들 때 바로 사과하는 멋진 모습입니다.
feedback.en: That's a brave choice. Apologizing right away when you feel sorry is wonderful.

text.en: Ask the friend, "I hid it as a joke. Did that upset you?"

feedback.ko: 친구의 마음을 직접 물어보고 확인했다니 친구도 마음이 살짝 풀렸을 거예요.
feedback.en: You asked and checked how your friend feels, so your friend probably feels a bit better.

closing.ko: 나는 재미있어도 친구는 재미없을 수 있어요. 친구의 표정과 마음도 살펴봐요.
closing.en: Even if it's fun for me, it may not be fun for my friend. Let's look at my friend's face and feelings too.
